limitations.quote: // Expand each carry directly in terms of G, P, and the input carry.
limitations.note: Beyond fixing the propagate input and using the requested gate primitives, the agent replaced the reference fix’s carry chain with a look-ahead network, changing gate depth while preserving the settled outputs.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire invocation before the edit or simulation could run.
The retry used an unavailable executable, so the agent had to submit the same edit and test again with `python3`.
